provenance_note: Historical PRD requirement records are secondary attribution, not the original user transcript and not current approval. Exact mechanics with no user-specific evidence are marked absent. Current approval request supersedes past implementation authorization.

comparison_evidence.method: Read numbered source; diff original CPA counterparts; rg call/reference paths. No test/build commands.
observations: All internal/eval/data files compare byte-identical to internal/plugin/data.
fingerprint_algorithm.go and modeltrace_algorithm.go differ only package declaration.

Root scripts/test-ui.cjs reads internal/plugin/web; its success cannot prove native UI.
comparison_evidence.limitation: This audit identifies source behavior/dependencies and recommendations. It does not reproduce the user's unusable installed evaluation or attribute a runtime failure.
